name: Signed By Identity
description: The Fulcio cert for this Rekor entry asserts this identity as the signer. v0 targets github_workflow; the target side is intentionally narrow until additional identity-node types arrive (raw email identities, GitLab workflows, etc.). Caller-supplied: the decompose helper emits this edge only when the caller passes a resolved identity entity id, performing no cross-plugin graph reads of its own.
